title: Gunter wraps up tough non-district slate against Sanger | Around The Web | wvnews.com
text:
GUNTER, Texas (KTEN)- We've got some Thursday night football this week as Gunter hits the road to take on Sanger.
The Tigers won that matchup a year ago 49-7 on their home turf.
GUNTER, Texas (KTEN)- We've got some Thursday night football this week as Gunter hits the road to take on Sanger.
The Tigers won that matchup a year ago 49-7 on their home turf.
This year won't be as easy. Sanger just put up 64 points last week and is 2-1 this season.
Sanger is also in class 4A. It's the third straight week where Gunter has gone up against a bigger school, a schedule that the Tigers believe will pay dividends come district play next week.
"To really get thrown in that fire the first couple weeks, there's nothing better that we could do," senior running back/defensive end Jay Campiti said. "Getting put in those big games, big opportunities, and go see what we're all about."
"I think when you have the opportunity to play some bigger schools that have some depth, a lot of real talent, it puts you in a position to feel those big pressure games," Gunter head coach Jordan Gill said. "We get a lot of questions answered early about the character of our team and the character of our kids and then also finding some things we need to work on to prepare us for those big games down the road."
